run_pretrain_gpt2: run the GPT2 pretraining script with distributed data parallel and model parallel support
build_gpt2_model: build a GPT2 model with configurable layers, hidden size, attention heads, and activation checkpointing
setup_optimizer: setup an Adam optimizer with weight decay parameter groups and optional FP16 mixed precision wrapping
train_gpt2: train the GPT2 model with forward and backward steps, gradient clipping, and learning rate scheduling
evaluate_gpt2: evaluate the GPT2 model on validation data and compute loss and perplexity metrics
